headline: Bring Agent DVR into Home Assistant
intro: Connect Agent DVR with its server IP address and port. Home Assistant can report alarm status, arm or disarm the system, and embed the Agent DVR viewer with a Webpage Card.
highlights: Connect to the server at its IP address and port
Use the alarm control panel to check status, arm, or disarm
Embed the Agent DVR viewer with a Webpage Card

flow.title: Connect and use Agent DVR
stages: Find the Agent DVR server IP address and port
Add Agent DVR from Settings > Devices & services
Use the alarm control panel or embed the viewer with a Webpage Card
